title.en: The stage, the screen and sport
title.fr: La scène, l'écran et le sport

text.en: The performing arts go back a long way in Canada and are well respected. Theatres form a regional network, and some Canadian companies are known around the world.
text.fr: Les arts de la scène ont une longue histoire au Canada et sont très respectés. Les théâtres forment un réseau régional, et certaines compagnies canadiennes sont connues dans le monde entier.

source.quote: Canada has a long and respected performing arts history, with a network of regional theatres and world-renowned performing arts companies.

verification.evidence: Canada has a long and respected performing arts history, with a network of regional theatres and world-renowned performing arts companies.

text.en: Atom Egoyan and Norman Jewison are two Canadian filmmakers worth knowing about.
text.fr: Atom Egoyan et Norman Jewison sont deux cinéastes canadiens à connaître.

source.quote: Other noteworthy Canadian filmmakers include Norman Jewison and Atom Egoyan.

verification.evidence: Other noteworthy Canadian filmmakers include Norman Jewison and Atom Egoyan.

text.en: Television made in Canada has been popular with viewers.
text.fr: La télévision faite au Canada a été populaire auprès du public.

source.quote: Canadian television has had a popular following.

verification.evidence: Canadian television has had a popular following.

text.en: Sport has done well across the country. Every province and territory has produced star athletes, both amateur and professional, and winners of Olympic medals.
text.fr: Le sport s'est développé partout au pays. Chaque province et chaque territoire a produit des athlètes vedettes, amateurs et professionnels, ainsi que des médaillés olympiques.

source.quote: Sports have flourished as all provinces and territories have produced amateur and professional star athletes and Olympic medal winners.

verification.evidence: Sports have flourished as all provinces and territories have produced amateur and professional star athletes and Olympic medal winners.

text.en: Canadian players take part in many of the big professional leagues.
text.fr: Des joueurs canadiens évoluent dans plusieurs grandes ligues professionnelles.

source.quote: Many major league sports boast Canadian talent

verification.evidence: Many major league sports boast Canadian talent and in the national sport of ice hockey, Canadian teams have dominated the world.

text.en: In ice hockey, Canadian teams have been the best in the world.
text.fr: Au hockey sur glace, les équipes canadiennes ont été les meilleures au monde.

source.quote: in the national sport of ice hockey, Canadian teams have dominated the world

verification.evidence: Many major league sports boast Canadian talent and in the national sport of ice hockey, Canadian teams have dominated the world.

text.en: At the Summer Olympic Games of 1996, the sprinter Donovan Bailey set a world record.
text.fr: Aux Jeux olympiques d'été de 1996, le sprinteur Donovan Bailey a établi un record du monde.

source.quote: In 1996 at the Olympic Summer Games, Donovan Bailey became a world record sprinter

verification.evidence: In 1996 at the Olympic Summer Games, Donovan Bailey became a world record sprinter and double Olympic gold medallist Chantal Petitclerc became a world champion wheelchair racer and Paralympic gold medallist.

text.en: Canadians came to see Terry Fox as a hero.
text.fr: Les Canadiens en sont venus à voir Terry Fox comme un héros.

source.quote: He became a hero to Canadians.

verification.evidence: In 1980, Terry Fox, a British Columbian who lost his right leg to cancer at the age of 18, began a cross-country run, the “Marathon of Hope,” to raise money for cancer research. He became a hero to Canadians.

text.en: Terry Fox did not finish his run across the country, and in the end cancer took his life. Fundraising events held every year in his name carry his work on.
text.fr: Terry Fox n'a pas terminé sa course à travers le pays, et le cancer a fini par l'emporter. Des collectes de fonds organisées chaque année en son nom poursuivent son œuvre.

source.quote: While he did not finish the run and ultimately lost his battle with cancer, his legacy continues through yearly fundraising events in his name.

verification.evidence: In 1980, Terry Fox, a British Columbian who lost his right leg to cancer at the age of 18, began a cross-country run, the “Marathon of Hope,” to raise money for cancer research. He became a hero to Canadians. While he did not finish the run and ultimately lost his battle with cancer, his legacy continues through yearly fundraising events in his name.
